steps.title: Trigger
steps.text: Something happens: an email lands, a form is sent, a schedule fires. I find the moment where the work really starts.

steps.title: Plan
steps.text: The agent decides what needs doing and which tools it may use. Limits come first, so it never wanders.

steps.title: Act
steps.text: It does the work in your real tools (CRM, sheets, inbox) with the same access a person on your team would have.

steps.title: Verify
steps.text: Every result is checked by code or a second model. When it is unsure, it stops and asks a person instead of guessing.

steps.title: Ship
steps.text: The result lands where your team already works, and every run is logged so it can be replayed later.
